configuration: NF4, bf16 compute, no double quantization, native RMS, eager, existing layer, rank 8
norm_protocol: m=0; unchanged neutral zh/en/ja prompts; last prefill position and each single-token decode position; full request bounded by the existing EOS/token/time limits
reference_rule: median of six medians: zh/en/ja times prefill/decode, all measured before injection under m=0; reject if any phase has no observations
coefficient_rule: a[0] = ratio * reference_norm / l2(U[:,0]); other seven coefficients zero; U unchanged; beta=max(abs(a[0])); one immutable coefficient per request

generation.sampling: full vocabulary multinomial; reset matched seed per condition; fresh KV
generation.extraction: reuse exact archived U and calibration pairs; do not re-fit or select direction

interpretation: Informational only; no sample-based parameter selection; not P5-31; report all failures and stop reasons. Same fixed reference for every language and generation phase.
